verdict.rationale: Reflect is a networked note-taking app, so an interactive graph view is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only bidirectional links, backlinks, and search filters by date, tags, backlinks, and pinned status, none of which is a visual graph. The API's "graphs" endpoints refer to the user's note database container, not a visualization, so neither the filters nor the API counts toward this story.
